title_zh: 商量早餐果酱并补上公用餐刀

scenario.goal_zh: 兼顾不同早餐偏好并确定共用与自用食材

context_zh: 合住者按各自口味商量早餐采购和公用餐具。
author: author-phase04-a

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I am buying breakfast things. Do you want jam for your toast?

sentences.speaker: Joanna
sentences.text: Yes, but not a very sweet one. Which of these three has the least sugar?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: The raspberry one, according to the labels. I will get that and some plain bread.

sentences.speaker: Joanna
sentences.text: Good. I will use the jam, and you can keep your own peanut butter.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: We also need another knife. The only one on the table is usually covered in peanut butter.

sentences.speaker: Joanna
sentences.text: I will buy a second one today so we have separate knives for the two jars.
